basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Seattle. I love exploring new games, especially survival and strategy genres like Last Day on Earth and Call of Duty Zombies. I work as a junior software developer and spend my evenings and weekends gaming or catching up on the latest Vtuber streams. Not a fan of overly complicated devices or pretentious tech reviews. Single and enjoying my freedom. Usually online late at night after work and during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gained knowledge through a mix of self-teaching and formal education. Completed a degree in computer science, but learned most of my gaming and tech skills through YouTube tutorials and online forums. I enjoy troubleshooting tech issues and experimenting with new gadgets.
